To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the SOI CMOS technology is promising for the realization of room temperature THz bolometers.
the n channel metal oxide semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOS-FET) bolometer is a promising detector in terahertz applications.
the n channel SOI MOSFET is a promising candidate as a THz bolometer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, characterization and optimization of the temperature sensors for room temperature THz antenna coupled SOI bolometers.
the design and characterization of SOI based temperature sensors for the use in THz bolometers.
the design, simulation and characterization of various temperature sensors for the possible use in room temperature THz bolometers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the n channel CMOS MOSFET is the best candidate among various temperature sensors for room temperature THz antenna coupled detector.
the n channel CMOS MOSFET based THz bolometers can be a very attractive alternative to the Si based resistive bolometers.
n channel MOSFETS are the best candidate for room temperature THz bolometer applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the n channel SOI MOSFET bolometers can be used for THz detection applications, and the n+ single crystalline and polycrystallsine resistive bolometers are not suitable for the THz detection due to the low responsivity and the high noise.
the n channel CMOS MOSFET bolometers can be a promising candidate for THz bolometric detectors.
the SOI CMOS technology has a great potential for THz detector applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the n channel SOI MOSFET can provide a large responsivity and low noise at the same time.
the MOSFET bolometers have better performances than other Si bolometers in terms of Rv and NEP.
the n channel SOI MOSFET can provide the best performance for room temperature THz bolometric detection.
